moveToFront.label: Bring to Front
moveToFront.description: Move to the front of all of the other drawings.

moveForward.label: Bring Forward
moveForward.description: Move forward one layer in the z order.

moveToBack.label: Send to Back
moveToBack.description: Move to the back of all of the other drawings.

moveBackward.label: Send Backward
moveBackward.description: Move backwards one layer in the z order.

selectAllDrawings.label: Select All Drawings
selectAllDrawings.description: Select all of the drawings on the sheet.

toggleLockAspectRatio.label: Lock Aspect Ratio
toggleLockAspectRatio.description: Toggle whether the aspect ratio should be maintained when resizing from corners.

formatAnchorTypeTwoCell.label: Move and size with cells
formatAnchorTypeTwoCell.description: Set your drawing to move and resize when underling sheet resizes.

formatAnchorTypeOneCell.label: Move but don't size with cells
formatAnchorTypeOneCell.description: Set your drawing to only move when underling sheet resizes.

formatAnchorTypeAbsolute.label: Don't move or size with cells
formatAnchorTypeAbsolute.description: Set your drawing to never move or resize when underling sheet resizes.

formatDrawNudgeLeft.label: Nudge Left
formatDrawNudgeLeft.description: Move the selected drawings 1 pixel left.

formatDrawNudgeRight.label: Nudge Right
formatDrawNudgeRight.description: Move the selected drawings 1 pixel right.

formatDrawNudgeUp.label: Nudge Up
formatDrawNudgeUp.description: Move the selected drawings 1 pixel up.

formatDrawNudgeDown.label: Nudge Down
formatDrawNudgeDown.description: Move the selected drawings 1 pixel down.

formatDrawNudgeLeftLarge.label: Nudge Left (Large)
formatDrawNudgeLeftLarge.description: Move the selected drawings 10 pixels left.

formatDrawNudgeRightLarge.label: Nudge Right (Large)
formatDrawNudgeRightLarge.description: Move the selected drawings 10 pixels right.

formatDrawNudgeUpLarge.label: Nudge Up (Large)
formatDrawNudgeUpLarge.description: Move the selected drawings 10 pixels up.

formatDrawNudgeDownLarge.label: Nudge Down (Large)
formatDrawNudgeDownLarge.description: Move the selected drawings 10 pixels down.

formatDrawRotateLeft.label: Rotate Left
formatDrawRotateLeft.description: Rotate the selected drawings 10 degrees counterclockwise.

formatDrawRotateRight.label: Rotate Right
formatDrawRotateRight.description: Rotate the selected drawings 10 degrees clockwise.

formatDrawAlignLeft.label: Align Left
formatDrawAlignLeft.description: Align the selected drawings to the left.

formatDrawAlignCenter.label: Align Center
formatDrawAlignCenter.description: Align the selected drawings vertically relative to each other.

formatDrawAlignRight.label: Align Right
formatDrawAlignRight.description: Align the selected drawings to the right.

formatDrawAlignTop.label: Align Top
formatDrawAlignTop.description: Align the selected drawings to the top.

formatDrawAlignMiddle.label: Align Middle
formatDrawAlignMiddle.description: Align the selected drawings horizontally relative to each other.

formatDrawAlignBottom.label: Align Bottom
formatDrawAlignBottom.description: Align the selected drawings to the bottom.

formatDrawDistributeHorz.label: Distribute Horizontally
formatDrawDistributeHorz.description: Distribute the selected drawings horizontally with equal spacing between each.

formatDrawDistributeVert.label: Distribute Vertically
formatDrawDistributeVert.description: Distribute the selected drawings vertically with equal spacing between each.

formatDrawGroup.label: Group
formatDrawGroup.description: Group the selected drawings into a single drawing.

formatDrawUngroup.label: Ungroup
formatDrawUngroup.description: Break the group of a drawing into individual drawings.

formatDrawSwapShapes.label: Swap Shapes
formatDrawSwapShapes.description: Swap the positions of the swap.

formatDrawSwapShapesHorz.label: Swap Shapes Horizontally
formatDrawSwapShapesHorz.description: Swap the positions of the swap horizontally.

formatDrawSwapShapesVert.label: Swap Shapes Vertically
formatDrawSwapShapesVert.description: Swap the positions of the swap vertically.
